newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM TO GET $40 PER NORTHWEST SHARE.
newsitem.headline: KLM TO GET $40 PER NORTHWEST SHARE.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Friday it would receive $40 per common share of Northwest Airlines for the sale of the first tranche of its holding in Northwest.
KLM said it would thus receive the maximum agreed price of $1.172 billion for the sale of its entire stake.
The sale of KLM's stake will take place in four different tranches over a period of three years. Payment for the first tranche will take place on October 1, 1997, the Dutch carrier said.
The sale of the remaining three tranches includes an accretion rate of approximately seven percent, it said.
This means that the price per share for each successive tranche will increase by approximately seven percent based on the $40 price of the first tranche, KLM said.
KLM and Northwest had previously agreed that the price per share would be between $36.50 and $40.
